{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=6 servings|time=1 ½ hours|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Desserts|Desserts]]

Bread pudding is a British Dessert. This version has banana and chocolate. 

==Ingredients==
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (20 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 0.71 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) semisweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] chips
* ⅓ cup (80 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 2.7 oz) spiced [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]  
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]] 
* 2 cups (450 ml / 15 oz) [[cookbook:Cream|whipping cream]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]]
* ⅓ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) white granulated [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
* 1 loaf (16 oz / 450 g) [[cookbook:Baguette|French bread]] or other non-sour white [[cookbook:bread|bread]] (stale bread is traditionally used)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]  
* 3 [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]]

==Procedure==
# In a cup or other small container, add 2 tablespoons of rum to the chocolate chips and soak them until they are needed later.
# In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, whipping cream, vanilla extract, rest of rum, and 3 tablespoons sugar.
# Slice the bread, trim off the crusts and cut it into strips. Divide the bread strips into three parts.
# Butter a [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf pan]].
# Peel the bananas, cut them in half crosswise and then lengthwise.
# In a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium heat, melt the butter and add the banana pieces with rest of sugar. cook 2 minutes, then flip the bananas over and cook the other side for 2 minutes.
# Cover the bottom of the loaf pan with bread strips (use ⅓ of the bread strips for this).
# Spread half of the banana pieces on top of the layer of bread strips.
# Spread half of the chocolate chips on top of the bananas.
# Add another layer of bread strips.
# Pour half of the egg mix into the loaf pan and let it soak in for a minute.
# Add the rest of the bananas, then the rest of the chocolate chips, then the rest of the bread strips. pour the rest of the egg mixture on top.
# Let the loaf pan sit for about 15 minutes while preheating the oven to {{Convert|350|F|C}}.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 50 minutes. let cool for 10–15 minutes.
# Serve with rum sauce, whipped cream or vanilla ice cream.
